units.source_text: 七菜是指春天的七种菜，

en.t: The seven herbs refer to the seven kinds of spring greens,

units.source_text: 即芹菜、荠菜、鼠曲草、繁缕、佛座、芜菁、萝卜。

en.t: namely celery, shepherd's purse, cudweed, chickweed, henbit, turnip, and radish.

units.source_text: 正月初七把这七种菜剁碎后放入粥里，叫作七菜粥。

en.t: On the seventh day of the first month, these seven greens were chopped and added to porridge, which was called seven-herb porridge.

units.source_text: 当时认为吃了能治百病。

en.t: At the time, people believed that eating it could cure all illnesses.
